blocks.text: Owner: Lena Ortiz    Campaign: 1–31 July 2027    Review: 18 June 2027

blocks.label: PRIMARY OBJECTIVE
blocks.text: Generate 120 qualified reservation inquiries during the launch month. This is a sample target, not a forecast or an achieved result.
People living or working within the local neighborhood who want a relaxed place for a midweek dinner. They need to understand the menu, typical spend and how to book before deciding.

rows: A seasonal dinner close to home
Menu highlights, room details, service hours and booking instructions
View the menu and request a table

blocks.text: Warm food-led photography, short ingredient descriptions and readable menu typography. Show the actual space when photographs are supplied. Avoid invented reviews, awards or claims about local sourcing.

items: Approved menu and prices; service dates and hours.
A clear booking route and accurate location information.
Confirmed dietary and accessibility guidance from the operator.

blocks.text: Chef reviews menu descriptions. Operations confirms hours and booking information. Campaign owner approves final copy before publication.

blocks.label: Allocate by the job to be done

blocks.text: Synthetic funnel: 8,000 landing visits → 1,200 menu opens → 180 inquiry starts → 120 completed inquiries. Completion is 1.5% of visits and 66.7% of starts. An inquiry is not a confirmed booking.

blocks.label: SPEND WITH A QUESTION
blocks.text: If the menu attracts attention but the form loses people, improve the form before buying more traffic. Targets and illustrative funnel values are not forecasts.

capabilities: Editorial emphasis, reconciled budget and funnel semantics
